derivation: amendment A3: a trailing '/' is significant, so `https://alpha.example/a/` is not the page url `https://alpha.example/a` and is outside the manifest: one informational `hreflang_external_target`, exit 0.

files.a.html:
<!doctype html>
<html><head>
<link rel="canonical" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://alpha.example/a">
<link rel="alternate" hreflang="en-GB" href="https://alpha.example/a/">
</head><body></body></html>

name: external-target-trailing-slash
